components.name: Botón Primario (Ámbar)
components.description: CTA principal. Ámbar sobre navy. Aparece en el hero y secciones oscuras.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #fabd2e; color: #0b1528; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Botón Ghost (Borde blanco)
components.description: CTA secundario sobre fondos oscuros. Aparece junto al primario en el hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

components.name: Botón Nav CTA
components.description: Botón Contáctanos en el header ámbar. Navy sobre ámbar.
components.css: .ds-btn-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #0e192f; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-nav:hover { background: #0e1625; } .ds-btn-nav:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

Certificación oficial

components.css: .ds-card { background: #f2f4f8; border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-card-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(14,25,47,0.08); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #0e192f; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #0e1625; margin: 0; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #5a687c; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Credencial de Certificación (Signature)
components.description: El elemento signature del sistema — la representación visual de "la caja azul" y la autorización MTT. Aparece en el hero right column.
components.html:
Autorizado por el Ministerio de Transportes de Chile

  • Equipos no adulterables
  • Certificación normativa vigente
  • Cobertura en 8 regiones
CLINITAXi · El de la caja azul
components.css: .ds-cert { border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); background: transparent; } .ds-cert-stripe { height: 4px; background: #fabd2e; } .ds-cert-body { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; } .ds-cert-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; } .ds-cert-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(250,189,46,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(250,189,46,0.3); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fabd2e; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-cert-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #ffffff; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0; } .ds-cert-divider { height: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-cert-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; } .ds-cert-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-cert-item svg { color: #fabd2e; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-cert-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-cert-footer svg { color: #fabd2e; }

components.name: Input de Contacto
components.description: Campo de formulario estándar. Superficie blanca, borde suave, focus navy.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5a687c; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d7dee8; border-radius: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #0e1625; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0e192f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(14,25,47,0.12); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9aa8bd; }

narrative.overview:
CLINITAXi's visual language is built around a single organizing truth: this is a physical, certified instrument — solid, precise, and officially stamped. The system does not perform modernity; it performs authority. Every surface is either the deep night navy of the device body or the near-white of a clean technical document. The amber arrives as a mark of certification — the color of the seal that makes something official — and it is used sparingly because its rarity is its power.

The design is official and precise, like a well-designed government form: structure is always visible, actions are never ambiguous, and ornament earns its presence only when it carries information. The system leans on weight and position for emphasis rather than color; when amber appears, it means something. When navy dominates, it means reliability.

The voice is direct and technical without being cold. A taxi driver on a phone should feel, in three seconds, that they have found the right place.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-first surfaces establish authority before the user reads a word
Amber as the certification signal — sparingly applied, always meaningful
Space Grotesk headlines carry the brand's precision; Inter body text keeps it accessible
JetBrains Mono labels add the 'technical instrument' register in small doses
Wave dividers in the hero are the only decorative element — all else is functional
Glassmorphism in the fixed nav is the only depth trick; everything else is flat or tonal

rules.name: La Regla del Ámbar
rules.body: Amber (#fabd2e) appears only on: primary CTAs, the accent stripe of the credential card, certification icons on dark surfaces, and the Header background. Amber never backgrounds a content section; it certifies, it does not decorate.

rules.name: La Regla del Éxito
rules.body: Success green (#0f8a4b) is reserved for state feedback — form validation confirmations, certification status chips, completed-step indicators. It is not a section label color.

rules.name: La Regla del Peso
rules.body: Emphasis comes from font weight and size, never from gradient text. A word that needs emphasis becomes Bold (700); a number that matters becomes Extrabold (800). Color alone never carries importance.

rules.name: La Regla de Plano
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The glassmorphism nav and the credential card shadow are the only elevation effects on the page. Adding a third shadow context dilutes all three.

dos: Do use #0e192f navy as the background for authority-bearing sections: hero, TrustBar, footer.
Do treat amber (#fabd2e) as the certification signal — reserve it for primary CTAs, credential icons, and the Header background.
Do apply Space Grotesk at 700–800 weight for all headings.
Do make the phone number a tel: link everywhere it appears — the primary user is on mobile.
Do keep the amber top stripe on the credential card — it is the visual stamp.
Do use rounded-sm (8px) on all interactive controls (buttons, inputs).
donts: Don't use success green (#0f8a4b) as a section label or eyebrow color.
Don't add a third shadow context beyond the nav glass and credential card.
Don't use gradient text — emphasis is weight and size.
Don't use hidden md:block on trust signals — the TrustBar must be visible on mobile.
Don't use plain <span> for the phone number — every appearance must be a tappable tel: link.
Don't use amber as a section background on light pages.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for section eyebrows — eyebrow kickers above headings are banned.
